method: mean abs diff on full-res gray 0-255 vs previous frame
rationale: Exact MD5 matches 0/30 lossy AA pairs after VP8 re-encode — near-dup required for RTC MediaRecorder. t=0.5 on full-res MAD: ~87% catch of intentional dups @VP8 1.5Mbps 720p, ~77% @150kbps 320x180; ~8.5% false-dup on 2s take4 talking-head consecutive frames (still keeps distinct fps ≥24 when true rate is ~30). Higher t improves catch but collapses static talking-head distinct fps below the live bar.
decode_note: ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough required: WebM VFR often has r_frame_rate=1000/1; default CFR conversion inflates frame count ~30×

synthetic_h264_AA.note: exact=30 (lossy not bit-identical); near catches dups
